# Data dictionary {#sec-data-dictionary}

```{r}
source("R/book.R")
dd <- read_pipeline("outputs", "data_dictionary.csv")
```

Every column of the vehicle table, `vehicles_enhanced.parquet`. The year
columns (`mileage_YYYY`, `legit_mileage_YYYY` and `pca_YYYY`) are shown once
each, with the range of their missing shares across the years. This table is
generated from the pipeline's `data_dictionary.csv`, so it always matches the
version of the data the book describes. *Missing* is the share of the
`r fmt_n(dd$n_rows[1])` vehicles with no value.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-data-dictionary
#| tbl-cap: "Columns of the vehicle table."
is_year <- grepl("_[0-9]{4}$", dd$column_name)
yr <- dd[is_year, ]
yr$stem <- sub("_[0-9]{4}$", "_YYYY", yr$column_name)
yr_sum <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(yr, yr$stem), function(x) {
  data.frame(column_name = x$stem[1], column_type = x$column_type[1],
             source = x$source[1],
             description = x$description[1],
             missing = paste0(min(x$pct_missing), "–", max(x$pct_missing), "%"))
}))
other <- dd[!is_year, ]
other$missing <- paste0(other$pct_missing, "%")
out <- rbind(other[, names(yr_sum)], yr_sum)
out$column_name <- paste0("`", out$column_name, "`")
kable(out, row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = c("Column", "Type", "Source", "Description", "Missing"))
```
